title: Inotiv, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: Inotiv, Inc., a Nasdaq-listed small-cap biotech/research company, disclosed that its lenders granted a waiver of the minimum liquidity covenant under its Credit Agreement for two specific test dates: April 17, 2026 and April 24, 2026. The waiver is limited in scope and does not amend any provisions of the underlying Credit Agreement.
key_points: Inotiv, Inc. (ticker: NOTV) is registered in Indiana and trades on Nasdaq.
Lenders granted a waiver of the minimum liquidity covenant for the April 17, 2026 test date.
Lenders granted a waiver of the minimum liquidity covenant for the April 24, 2026 test date.
The waiver is limited to the specified test dates and does not constitute an amendment to the Credit Agreement.
The Credit Agreement was originally dated November 5, 2021, with subsequent amendments.
The filing was signed by Beth A. Taylor, CFO and Executive Vice President, on April 20, 2026.
